headline: Congress keeps it brief with back-to-back pro forma sessions while committees stay dark before the weekend!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Tuesday, September 8, meeting for just 27 seconds before adjourning. No business was conducted as the chamber was in a brief procedural session.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Tuesday, September 8, for just 3 minutes with no votes taken. Twenty-two public bills and six resolutions were introduced, and thirteen committee reports were filed covering topics ranging from veterans' education to tax administration and civil rights compliance.
